integrity: Classical Farey criterion and lattice method attributed to prior literature; computations are corroborative only; proof is analytic; no external certification or independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed power exponents; limiting rather than uniform growing-threshold gap tails; no assertion about filtered-subsequence neighbors. An earlier unindexed power-conditioned law is not ruled out.
title: Power-conditioned Farey neighbors have a universal heavy-tail spacing law
